title: Standing Architectural Rules & Ledger Schema
description: Standing architectural rules and mechanical verification contracts governing the Stitch SDK non-breaking bridge.

PRESERVE_BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY.summary: Do not break existing consumers when introducing fixes and new functionality.
antiPatterns: Breaking changes in minor or patch releases
Removing methods or properties without deprecation periods
PRESERVE_BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY.remediation: Provide additive signatures, overloads, or non-breaking adapters with @deprecated annotations.

POLYMORPHIC_ARGUMENT_ROUTING.summary: Methods migrating to trailing options objects must accept legacy positional parameters.
POLYMORPHIC_ARGUMENT_ROUTING.remediation: Accept union parameter types or overloads (e.g. titleOrOptions?: string | Options) and normalize at runtime.

DUCK_TYPED_RESULT_CONTAINERS.summary: Result containers replacing single-entity returns must implement or extend the entity.
antiPatterns: Returning a standalone Generation container that is not assignable to Screen
Breaking Promise<Screen> consumers with an incompatible container
DUCK_TYPED_RESULT_CONTAINERS.remediation: Extend the base entity or proxy property access to the primary screen so existing callers continue to work.

ADDITIVE_CONTENT_ACCESSORS.summary: Do not repurpose existing URL getter methods to return raw payload content.
antiPatterns: Changing screen.getHtml(): Promise<string> from returning a URL to returning HTML content
Changing screen.getImage(): Promise<string> from returning a URL to returning Uint8Array bytes
ADDITIVE_CONTENT_ACCESSORS.remediation: Retain URL return semantics on getHtml() and getImage() with @deprecated, and introduce readHtml() / readImage() for content.

NON_BREAKING_TYPE_INTERSECTIONS.summary: Do not break user access to unmodeled entity data with strict unknown types.
antiPatterns: Strict unknown on open data dictionaries
NON_BREAKING_TYPE_INTERSECTIONS.remediation: Intersect typed interfaces with index signatures (ScreenData & Record<string, any>) or retain permissive typings.

PUBLIC_CONSTRUCTOR_HYDRATION.summary: Do not seal public constructors to protected without deprecation transitions.
antiPatterns: Throwing runtime errors on new Entity(...)
PUBLIC_CONSTRUCTOR_HYDRATION.remediation: Retain public constructors, hydrate properties properly, register with EntityManager, and mark with @deprecated.

TREE_SHAKEABLE_ROOT_EXPORTS.summary: Do not remove public root exports when package tree-shaking metadata can reduce bundle size.
antiPatterns: Removing toolDefinitions and toolMap from root export
Forcing breaking subpath migrations without deprecation
TREE_SHAKEABLE_ROOT_EXPORTS.remediation: Re-export from root with @deprecated pointing to subpath, relying on sideEffects: false.
